label: Exploratory lower-turnover momentum; prior holdout failure is preserved
universe: Same 12 eligible Wallex USDT markets, no outcome-selected assets
variants_unit: hours between scheduled rebalances and maximum holding time
rebalance: Allow a same-time exit and entry at the scheduled next open; charge both fills, even when the selected asset is unchanged
features: Closed hourly EMA200; 7-day and 28-day returns; 7-day return volatility; ATR14 on strictly completed daily bars
entry: At scheduled UTC midnight: both momentum returns positive, close above hourly EMA200, 7-day gross momentum above twice assumed round-trip cost; choose highest (7-day return minus cost) / 7-day volatility
risk: One spot-long position, max 100 USDT all-in; 0.1% account planned risk; stop 2 daily ATR; target 2R net; no averaging down
costs: Unchanged fee 0.2% per side; historical spread proxy max(15 bps round trip, measured current per-market spread); additional slippage 1 bp per side
stress: Double spread and extra slippage, unchanged fees
evaluation: Full available replay after feature warmup; both variants reported, no selecting a winning date interval; no claim of an untouched holdout or prospective live performance
reason: Reduce fee turnover and let movements develop; weekly reference may exceed the three-day challenge horizon
